[[Kepkhet's Refuge]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Kepkhet Marrowfeast]], a [[boss]] in [[Prophet's Path]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of [[Protection Prayers]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment spell|Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:Energy +5

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as [[Brohn's Staff]] and [[Droknar's Staff]] but slightly darker in colour.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following Divine Favor staves:
**[[Holy Staff]] from collector [[Nord Stonegrimm]]
**[[Lotus Staff]] from collector [[Kristoffir Roi]]
**[[Protective Staff]] from collectors [[Jung Zeng]] or [[Denos Makaluum]] or crafters [[Manzo]], [[Mathilde]], or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]

==Unique counterpart==
[[Chaelse's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Holy damage]] and requires [[Protection Prayers]].

==Notes==
*In 2007, the skin was updated to a darker tone and the stats for Staff Head and Staff Wrapping in the item description display were reversed.
